agent.problem: Cards 2, 4 and 6 are all discovery questions: the earlier cards give no basis for choosing Rabbah, seeking an omen, or Jerusalem rather than Rabbah. Three of the stop's five choices therefore come down to luck, so most of this stop's choices are not informed guesses and the discovery questions go beyond the allowed few.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

agent.problem: The second sentence retells Ezekiel 21:20 by identifying Rabbah as the city at the end of the other road, but the card cites only Ezekiel 21:28.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
